descripcion_geo: City of the Decapolis east of the Galilee lake. Hellenistic region with strong Gentile presence; scene of the exorcism of the two demoniacs.

historias.titulo: Jesus heals the demon-possessed man of Gadara
historias.descripcion: Jesus crosses the lake and in the region of the Gadarenes/Gerasenes heals a man with a legion of demons; the pigs run to the lake.

historias.titulo: The demoniac of Gadara evangelizes the Decapolis
historias.descripcion: Healed, the man asks to follow Jesus; Jesus orders him to return and tell what he did to him; he proclaims it throughout the Decapolis.

historias.titulo: Pigs as a sign of gentle land
historias.descripcion: The presence of a large herd of pigs at Gadara indicates that it was Gentile territory; Jesus ministers there extending his mission beyond Israel.

personajes.descripcion: He crossed the lake to heal the demon-possessed man in a Gentile land; sign of the universality of his ministry.
Healed by Jesus, he proclaimed the gospel in ten cities of the Decapolis.
They asked Jesus to leave their region after losing the pig herd.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Gadara (Decapolis): relevant region in the NT world.

cristianismo.descripcion: The healing of the demon-possessed man of Gadara shows that Christ's power over the 'legion' (a metaphor for Roman and demonic power) reaches even to Gentile land.
